'''Calder Byra''' was a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] socialite connected to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] high society.

==Biography==
Calder Brya was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] socialite with connections to the highest levels of society on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A rich man of noble [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]], he had over one million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in his [[Bank/Legends|bank]] account and was also a [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] player.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds" />

==Personality and traits==
Brya had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], light skin, and a fit and trim build. He was also considered good-looking. Byra had the natural gift of connecting with people, and despite being the type of rich socialite people loved to hate, his worst critics walked away with a positive outlook on him. Byra's sense of humor was self-deprecating and disarming.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds" />

==Skills and abilities==
The socialite could speak, read, and write with the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], and [[Twi'leki/Legends|Ryl]] [[Language/Legends|languages]]. He also spoke [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]], though could not read or write it.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Calder Byra was introduced the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', as an ally or antagonist for Coruscant-based roleplaying campaigns. The character was not tied to a specific era.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds" />
